capabilities: Draw a dependency graph of tasks
Schedule tasks on a Gantt chart with critical path
Compute time-and-materials costs from a rates note
Write dates, dependencies and people back to Markdown
extras: Finance is off by default and needs a rates note in the vault; requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer; interface available in English, Dutch and Simplified Chinese; blocks tagged tasks-map from the earlier name still render.
intentEvidence: Project Planner began life as a fork of Tasks Map by Nico Klaassen
motivation: The author found that most task plugins are good at capture and weak at planning, so built a planner around dependencies rather than dates.
problem: Task plugins capture what is due but do not show which task, if it slips, actually moves the delivery date.

relations.evidence: Project Planner began life as a fork of Tasks Map by Nico Klaassen
Reads inline - [ ] checkbox tasks out of your vault. The views refuse to render without it.
Adds Create task and Edit task to the node context menu, using the Tasks plugin's own modal.

summary: Project-planning views over existing Markdown tasks: a dependency graph, a Gantt chart with critical path, a kanban board and time-and-materials costing.
